title: 第11章 传承者的线索第12章 寻找传承者
lines: 天越来越黑，风也渐渐小了。
黑石镇的灯火还亮着，街上偶尔传来低低的说话声、轻轻的脚步声。熬过了半年提心吊胆的日子，小镇总算能喘口气了，连空气里都透着一股久违的平静。镇民们各自忙活着，收拾残局、养伤休息、商量以后怎么过日子，再不像从前那样，一到晚上就怕得不行。
这份安宁，是真的。
可地底深处那种古老的寂静，其实从来都没散过。
陆寻站在街口，静静看了一会儿，目光又落回镇中心那座废弃工坊。
白天的厮杀太乱了，枪炮声、喊打声混成一片，完全盖住了地下的动静。直到一切平息下来，那种埋在工坊地基下面的厚重阻滞感，才又隐隐约约浮现出来。它不凶，也不躁动，就像一块沉在河底千万年的石头，又老又沉默，冷冷看着人间的热闹起落。
左腿旧伤一阵一阵地酸胀发疼，时刻提醒着陆寻：他这副身子骨是有极限的。他不是什么天生强者，不过是在废墟和厮杀里摸爬滚打，硬生生练出了一身过于谨慎的求生本能。越是看起来太平的时候，他越要挖出底下藏着的危险，绝不会被短暂的安稳糊弄过去。
“还要进去？”苏野看出他的打算，低声问。
“嗯。”陆寻点了点头，语气平静却肯定，“白天打得急，工坊只粗粗查了一遍。地底下那个锚点到底怎么回事，还没彻底弄清楚。”
林小满也跟着迈步，眼神清澈，没有一点犹豫。她的精神感知还维持着低限度铺开的状态，休息了这么久，透支的精神力稍微恢复了一些，虽然还是累，但足够支撑她仔细探查了。
“我跟你们一起。”她轻声补充，“里面没有活物的敌意，但那种旧时代的沉重感，确实都聚在工坊地底下。”
三人没再多说，借着镇上暖黄的灯光，又一次走向镇中心的废弃工坊。
街上畅通无阻，路过的镇民看见他们，都停下来侧身致意。没人围上来打扰，只用最朴实的方式，表达心里最真诚的敬意。这份敬意不是因为害怕强者，而是绝境逃生之后，普通人对于救命之人最真心的认可。
短短一夜，遭过大难的黑石镇，人心和局面已经彻底变了。
工坊那扇破门依旧斑斑驳驳，裂缝交错，木头都快烂了，一副被岁月啃光了的样子。可奇怪的是，白天那么多人在这里打打杀杀、兵器乱撞，却没能动这扇门分毫。看起来一碰就碎，实际上却被一股无形的力量牢牢固定着，风吹雨打、战火纷飞，它始终纹丝不动。
一脚踏进工坊，外面的暖风、人声，一下子全被隔开了。
屋里空气又冷又闷，一丝风都没有，温度比外面低了好几度，呼吸都能呵出白气。满屋子陈年的灰尘混着淡淡的铁锈味扑面而来，没有血腥和腐烂气，只有旧时代建筑被封存百年后那种荒凉。
空荡荡的厂房里，盗匪留下的破烂已经被镇民清理干净了。地上铺了薄薄一层新灰，盖掉了之前打斗的痕迹，只剩下满地的锈齿轮、断掉的金属件和废弃零件，静静躺在黑暗里，默默背着逝去的年月。
整个空间死寂一片，压得人喘不过气。
林小满轻轻皱了皱眉，低声说出感知到的情况：“波动还在，很平稳，节奏非常慢，没有任何攻击性。像是某种基础能量在恒温运转，范围就死死固定在这片地基下面，不扩散、不减弱、也没什么异常动静。”
陆寻直接走向工坊正中央那块方形的青石板。
这是整个工坊最奇怪的地方。石板表面平整干净，没积灰也没裂缝，和周围又糙又破的石基形成了鲜明对比，一看就是人工修整过的。白天打得最凶的时候，这块石板曾经短暂亮起过灰白色的纹路，还引动了远处不知名的动静。现在虽然恢复了平静，但地底透出的那股厚重压迫感，依然清晰可辨。
他单膝蹲下，特意让左腿少受力，手指再次轻轻抚过石板表面。
冰凉、密实、坚硬。手感普通，没有奇怪的纹路，没有符文刻痕，也没有机械开关，朴素得就像最普通的建筑石料。
可越是看起来普通，就越透着一股说不出的诡异。
废墟世界这一百年来，天灾不断、战火连天，能完好留到今天的建筑，绝对不可能是寻常东西。
苏野持枪站在侧后方，目光扫过四周阴暗的角落，全程高度戒备。他感觉不到那些隐晦的规则波动，但在生死厮杀里练出来的直觉很清楚——这片安静的废墟中心，藏着比盗匪作乱更深远、更危险的秘密。
“下面是空的？”苏野低声问。
“很可能是空的。”陆寻应道，指尖沿着石板边缘仔细摸索，“这块方石板是个盖子，不是地基原来的石头。”
常年在荒野求生的经验，让他对石材质感、建筑结构的判断非常精准。石板四周的缝隙极细，早就被尘土和岁月悄悄堵死了，不仔细查根本发现不了。人工封藏的痕迹，被藏得非常隐蔽。
陆寻抽出腰间的短刀，把刀尖插进缝隙，轻轻一撬。
咔。
一声沉闷又细微的石头摩擦声，在死寂的工坊里显得格外清楚。
整块厚重的石板微微松动了，没有笨重卡住的感觉，顺滑得像是经常开合、反复磨合过的精密机关。
三人神色同时一凝，注意力全集中到了洞口。
陆寻收回短刀，用手抵住石板慢慢发力推开。左肩的伤口被牵动，细碎的灼痛顺着皮肉蔓延开来，他脸上却没什么表情，稳稳控制着力道，把石板横着推开了半尺宽。
一道漆黑的洞口，一下子露了出来。
下面是垂直向下的石头台阶，幽深安静，看不见底。一股比工坊里面更厚重、更古老的荒凉气息扑面而来，通道里没风也没声，没有活物的动静，只剩下沉淀了百年的、纯粹的岁月沉寂。
“我先下。”陆寻沉声道。
“小心。”林小满立刻收紧感知，全身心锁定洞口下方，“没有突然爆发的杀机，但这地方年代太久远了，沉积的气息特别重。”
陆寻微微点头，侧身踏进洞口的石阶。
石阶干燥稳固，没有青苔打滑，每一级大小都很规整，是典型的旧时代人工建造工艺。通道很窄，只够一个人走，两边的石壁又冷又平，把外面所有的灯光和暖意彻底隔绝了。越往下走，周围越冷，那种压抑感也一层层叠加上来。
苏野紧跟在他后面，持枪低姿戒备，枪口始终对着前方的黑暗，随时准备应付突发危险；林小满走在最后，全程放开精神感知，牢牢锁定整个地下空间的所有细微动静。
往下走了二十多级台阶，脚终于踩到了平地，通道尽头的视野一下子开阔起来。
这是一间格局规整的地下石室。
content_en:
The sky is getting darker and the wind is getting lighter.
The lights in Blackstone Town were still on, and occasionally low voices and light footsteps could be heard on the street. After half a year of being on tenterhooks, the town could finally take a breath, and there was a long-lost calm in the air. The townspeople were busy cleaning up the mess, recuperating and resting, and discussing how to live their lives in the future. They were no longer as scared as before, when night came.
This peace is real.
But the ancient silence deep underground has never disappeared.
Lu Xun stood at the street corner and watched quietly for a while, then his eyes fell back to the abandoned workshop in the center of the town.
The fighting during the day was so chaotic that the sound of gunfire and shouting mixed together, completely covering up the movement underground. It wasn't until everything calmed down that the heavy feeling of stagnation buried under the foundation of the workshop vaguely emerged again. It is neither fierce nor restless, just like a stone that has sunk at the bottom of the river for thousands of years, old and silent, coldly watching the ups and downs of the world.
The old injury on his left leg was sore and painful, constantly reminding Lu Xun that his body and bones had their limits. He is not a naturally strong person, but he has developed an overly cautious survival instinct by crawling around in the ruins and fighting. The more peaceful it seems, the more he wants to dig out the danger hidden underneath, and he will never be fooled by the short-term stability.
"Want to go in?" Su Ye saw his plan and asked in a low voice.
"Yes." Lu Xun nodded, his tone calm but affirmative, "We were in a hurry during the day, so the workshop only made a rough inspection. What happened to the anchor point underground has not yet been fully understood."
Lin Xiaoman followed suit, with clear eyes and no hesitation. Her mental perception was still at a low level. After resting for such a long time, her overdrawn mental power had recovered a little. Although she was still tired, it was enough to support her careful exploration.
"I'm with you." She added softly, "There is no hostility from living creatures, but the heaviness of the old times is indeed gathered under the workshop."
The three of them said nothing more and walked towards the abandoned workshop in the center of the town again under the warm yellow light of the town.
The streets were smooth and the townspeople passing by stopped and turned to greet them when they saw them. No one came around to disturb him, he only expressed his most sincere respect in the simplest way. This respect is not due to fear of the strong, but the most sincere recognition of ordinary people for the person who saved their lives after escaping from a desperate situation.
In just one night, the hearts and situation of Blackstone Town, which had suffered a catastrophe, had completely changed.
The broken door of the workshop is still mottled and cracked, and the wood is almost rotten, looking like it has been gnawed away by time. But the strange thing is that during the day, so many people were fighting and clashing weapons here, but they couldn't move the door at all. It seems to be broken at the touch of a touch, but in fact it is firmly held in place by an invisible force. It remains motionless despite the wind and rain and the flames of war.
As soon as I stepped into the workshop, the warm air and human sounds outside were suddenly separated.
The air in the room was cold and stuffy, with no wind at all. The temperature was several degrees lower than outside, and my breath was white. The house was full of old dust mixed with a faint smell of rust. There was no smell of blood or decay, only the desolation of old-era buildings that had been sealed away for hundreds of years.
In the empty factory, the rags left by the bandits have been cleaned up by the townspeople. A thin layer of fresh dust was spread on the ground, covering up the traces of the previous fight. Only rusty gears, broken metal parts and discarded parts were left on the ground, lying quietly in the darkness, silently carrying the passing years.
The entire space was filled with dead silence, which made people breathless.
Lin Xiaoman frowned slightly and whispered what he perceived: "The fluctuations are still there, very stable, with a very slow rhythm and no aggression. It's like some kind of basic energy is running at a constant temperature, and the range is firmly fixed under this foundation. It does not spread, does not weaken, and there is no abnormal movement."
Lu Xun walked directly towards the square bluestone slab in the center of the workshop.
This is the strangest place in the entire workshop. The surface of the stone slab is smooth and clean, with no dust or cracks. It is in sharp contrast with the rough and broken stone foundations around it. It can be seen that it has been artificially repaired. During the day when the fighting was the fiercest, the stone slab briefly lit up with gray-white lines and caused unknown movements in the distance. Although calm has been restored now, the heavy pressure coming from the ground is still clearly discernible.
He squatted down on one knee, deliberately putting less stress on his left leg, and gently stroked his fingers across the stone surface again.
Cold, dense, hard. It feels ordinary, with no strange lines, no rune marks, and no mechanical switches. It is as simple as the most ordinary building stones.
But the more ordinary it looks, the more indescribably weird it appears.
In the past hundred years, there have been constant natural disasters and wars in the ruined world. It is absolutely impossible for the buildings that have survived intact to this day to be ordinary things.
Su Ye stood at the side and back with a gun, his eyes scanning the dark corners around him, and he was on high alert the whole time. He couldn't feel the fluctuations of those obscure rules, but his intuition, which he had honed in the life-and-death fight, was very clear - in the center of this quiet ruin, there were hidden secrets that were more profound and dangerous than the banditry.
"Is it empty down there?" Su Ye asked in a low voice.
"It's probably empty." Lu Xun responded, groping carefully along the edge of the stone slab with his fingertips, "This square stone slab is a cover, not the original stone of the foundation."
Years of experience in surviving in the wilderness have allowed him to judge stone textures and architectural structures very accurately. The gaps around the stone slabs are extremely thin and have long been quietly blocked by dust and time. They cannot be discovered without careful inspection. The traces of artificial sealing are very hidden.
Lu Xun took out the short knife from his waist, inserted the tip of the knife into the gap, and pried it gently.
Click.
There was a dull and subtle sound of stones rubbing together, which was particularly clear in the dead silence of the workshop.
The entire thick stone slab was slightly loose, without the feeling of being bulky or stuck. It was as smooth as a precision mechanism that had been opened and closed frequently and worn repeatedly.
The three people's expressions froze at the same time, and all their attention was focused on the entrance of the cave.
Lu Xun retracted his short knife, put his hand against the stone slab and slowly pushed it away. The wound on his left shoulder was affected, and tiny burning pain spread along the flesh. However, his face showed no expression. He steadily controlled his strength and pushed the stone slab half a foot wide horizontally.
A dark hole was suddenly revealed.
Below are stone steps that go vertically downward, deep and quiet, with no bottom visible. An aura of desolation that was thicker and older than that in the workshop came to my face. There was no wind or sound in the passage, and there was no movement of living creatures. Only the pure silence of the years that had accumulated for a hundred years was left.
"I'll get off first." Lu Xun said solemnly.
"Be careful." Lin Xiaoman immediately tightened his senses and focused all his attention on the bottom of the cave entrance. "There is no sudden murderous intention, but this place is too old, and the accumulated aura is particularly heavy."
Lu Xun nodded slightly and stepped sideways into the stone steps at the entrance of the cave.
The stone steps are dry and stable, without slippery moss, and the size of each step is very regular. It is a typical artificial construction process of the old era. The passage is very narrow, only big enough for one person to walk. The stone walls on both sides are cold and flat, completely cutting off all the light and warmth outside. The further down you go, the colder the surroundings get, and the sense of depression builds up layer by layer.
Su Ye followed closely behind him, holding a gun in a low posture, keeping his muzzle pointed at the darkness ahead, ready to deal with sudden dangers; Lin Xiaoman walked at the end, letting go of his mental perception throughout the process, firmly locking on all the subtle movements in the entire underground space.
After walking down more than 20 steps, my feet finally touched the ground, and the view at the end of the passage suddenly broadened.
This is an underground stone room with a regular layout.
title_en: Chapter 11 Clues to the Inheritor Chapter 12 Looking for the Inheritor
